The Problem

Education is broken for 250 million students.

Students from regional backgrounds struggle because educational content is English-only with zero personalized feedback. This leads to poor comprehension and unequal access to quality education for millions. VidyaAI bridges this gap by delivering localized, adaptive tutoring to every student.

250M

Indian students study in English: a language they aren't fluent in.

1:40

Teacher-to-student ratio. No one can personalize for 40 students.

60%

Rural students score below grade level due to language barriers.
